description: Send a file from the user's own computer into a notebook, for a client that can run a command there (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor): a recording to transcribe (.mp3 .m4a .wav .ogg .webm .flac .mp4 .mpeg .mpga, WhatsApp voice notes .opus, .aac .amr .3gp .3ga .wma .oga) or a document (.pdf .docx .txt .md .csv .tsv), up to 1 GB. Give the file name and its exact size_bytes, and sha256 when you can. Returns an upload_url and ready commands: one curl PUT for a file up to 32 MB, else a short Python script that sends 32 MB chunks with Content-Range and resumes after an interruption. Run the command on the computer that holds the file; the bytes never pass through the conversation. Without notebook_id a new notebook named after the file (or title) is made when the last byte arrives. A recording takes one place in the account's transcription allowance, which depends on its plan and renews with its credits; the reply says how many places are left. Follow it with get_knowledge_upload.

app_id.description: Optional app whose notebooks to use. Omitted: the owner's own Business Brain.

filename.description: The file's name with its extension, e.g. meeting-11-12.m4a.

notebook_id.description: Optional: an existing notebook. Omitted: a new one.

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of the file; a mismatch is refused.

size_bytes.description: The exact file size in bytes.

title.description: Title for the new notebook, when notebook_id is omitted.

name: create_knowledge_upload
